effectEntries.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.
effectEntries.shortEffect: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target.

effectEntries.effect: Inflige des dégâts réguliers. Le lanceur subit 1/3 des dégâts qu'il inflige en contrecoup. A une chance de brûler la cible. Les Pokémon gelés peuvent utiliser cette capacité, auquel cas ils seront dégèleront.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Le lanceur subit 1/3 des dégâts infligés en contrecoup. A une chance de brûler la cible.

descriptions.text: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. The user sustains serious damage and may leave the target burned.

The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user and may leave the target with a burn.
